statci: Statistical CI/CD, Calibration Fuzzing, and Manuscript Auditing

Source: R/statci-package.R
statci-package.Rd

Automated continuous integration and verification tools for statistical R pipelines, methods packages, and Quarto/RMarkdown/LaTeX manuscripts.

Verification Pillars

  • AST Statistical Linter & PR Diff Linting: stat_lint(), stat_lint_text(), stat_lint_dir(), stat_lint_diff(), list_stat_rules(), new_stat_rule(), register_stat_rule(), export_statci_sarif().

  • Estimator Calibration, SBC, Power & Parallel RNG: audit_estimator(), audit_sbc(), audit_power_curve(), check_parallel_rng(), statci_parallel_apply().

  • Manuscript-to-Code Consistency Auditor: audit_manuscript(), audit_manuscript_text().

  • Adversarial Sensitivity & Multiverse Robustness: audit_sensitivity(), audit_multiverse().

  • Orchestration, Reports & GitHub Actions: read_statci_config(), statci_audit_project(), statci_report(), render_statci_report(), statci_check_gate(), use_statci_github_action().
